ukm:Metadata.dc:title: The Education (Student Support) Regulations 2011
ukm:Metadata.dc:subject: EDUCATION, ENGLAND
ukm:Metadata.dc:description: These Regulations provide for support for students taking designated higher education courses in respect of an academic year beginning on or after 1st September 2012.

Part.Title: GRANTS FOR LIVING AND OTHER COSTS

P2para.Text: An eligible student (“A”) qualifies in connection with A's attendance on a designated course for the parents' learning allowance if A has one or more dependants who are dependent children.
The amount of parents' learning allowance payable in respect of an academic year is calculated in accordance with regulation 47, the basic amount being £2,024.

Para.Text: Sum in reg. 46(2) substituted (6.3.2025) by The Education (Student Fees, Awards and Support) (Amendment) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/162), reg. 1(b), Sch. 2 (with reg. 2(2)(c)(4))
